newsitem.title: USA: Pyramid Breweries sees break-even Q4.
newsitem.headline: Pyramid Breweries sees break-even Q4.

text.p: Pyramid Breweries Inc said Tuesday it expects fourth quarter wholesale beer sales to be 20 to 25 percent below last year's levels, below analysts' expectations.
As a result of the disappointing sales and increased spending on geographical expansion, the company said it expects earnings for the quarter to be near break-even.
On average, analysts had expected the company to earn $0.09 a share in the quarter and $0.41 a share for the year, according to First Call.
Pyramid stock, which went public at 19 as Hart Brewing Co in December 1995, was off 1/4 at 4.
The company said its sales in Western states have fallen due to increased competition from a growing number of craft breweries and line extensions by them.
Just last week Pyramid's crosstown rival Redhook Ale Brewery Inc said sales for the quarter would be below expectations. It also cited weakness in West Coast sales.
